changelog: - **A loop that returns to a full Pool exactly what it takes from it no longer stands still.** Where a Converter is fed by Gates, or a Gate is fed from more than one place, a group may take from a Pool and put back into it in the same step; what it takes makes the room for what it returns. When the Pool was exactly full and the group returned exactly what it took, nothing moved: a Pool holding 10 of 10, a Gate taking 3 and sending six sevenths straight back and one seventh through a Converter back into the same Pool, stayed frozen, while the same model with the slightest room in the Pool ran in full. The engine’s arithmetic made the Pool’s level come out a hair above full where it is exactly full, and its search for the amount to move read that hair as an overflow at every amount it tried. It now tells that hair from a real inflow by how it changes with the amount, without loosening any limit: anything that would really overfill the Pool, by however little, is still refused. None of the bundled examples changes. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 12).
